question: A cue must hit 45 feet into a 35 mm reel; film runs 16 frames a foot, 24 a second. How many seconds in?
move: Convert to the unit the machine counts in, then convert back.
trap: Treating feet of film as if they mapped to seconds one to one.
hint: Turn the length of film into frames first.
reference: Karlin and Wright, On the Track: A Guide to Contemporary Film Scoring, 2nd edition, Routledge, 2004
